title: gateway_GATEWAY_ID_PLACEHOLDER__query-transactions___query_transactions
description: Look up the authenticated merchant's OWN payment transactions (status, amount, method, date, transaction id). Read-only and always filtered to the caller's merchant_id, which is injected server-side by the gateway interceptor.

instruction.instruction: Call this to answer questions about the caller's transactions. NEVER pass merchant_id, merchant, tenant, or account id - the system injects the caller's merchant_id from the verified session. Never request or accept another merchant's id. Pass only the narrowing fields the user provided.
examples: User: "show my failed payments" -> call with { "status": "FAILED" }
User: "what is the status of transaction txn_123" -> call with { "transactionId": "txn_123" }
User: "did my refunds go through this week" -> call with { "query": "refunds this week" }

transactionId.description: Optional specific transaction id to look up.

query.description: Optional free-text description of what the merchant is asking about.

limit.description: Max number of transactions to return.
